REST API for creating and managing Cloudflare Queues, sending and receiving messages, configuring consumers (Worker push or HTTP pull), managing dead letter queues, purging queues, and retrieving queue metrics and event subscriptions. Authenticated with Cloudflare API tokens via Bearer authorization.
